n, m, Mod = map(int, input().split())

MAXNODES = 577

# Initialize combination matrix C
C = [[0] * MAXNODES for _ in range(MAXNODES)]
for i in range(MAXNODES):
    C[i][0] = 1
    C[i][i] = 1
for i in range(1, MAXNODES):
    for j in range(1, i):
        C[j][i] = (C[j][i - 1] + C[j - 1][i - 1]) % Mod

def sumInterval(start, end):
    return ((start + end) * (end - start + 1) // 2) % Mod

dp = [0] * (n + 1)
dp2 = [0] * (n + 1)
dp[0] = 1
dp2[0] = 0

for length in range(1, n + 1):
    for i in range(1, length + 1):
        sum_val = sumInterval(1, i - 1) + sumInterval(1, length - i)
        total = length + 1
        val1 = (dp[i - 1] * total) % Mod * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1] % Mod
        val2 = (sum_val * dp[i - 1]) % Mod * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1] % Mod
        val3 = (dp2[i - 1] * total) % Mod * dp[length - i] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1] % Mod
        val4 = (dp2[length - i] * total) % Mod * dp[i - 1] % Mod * C[i - 1][length - 1] % Mod

        if length == 1:
            dp[length] = (dp[length] + val1) % Mod
            dp2[length] = (dp2[length] + val2 + val3 + val4) % Mod
        else:
            dp[length] = (dp[length] + val1) % Mod
            dp2[length] = (dp2[length] + val2 + val3 + val4) % Mod

res = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
res2 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(m, i) + 1):
        res[i][j] = res[i - 1][j]
        res2[i][j] = res2[i - 1][j]
        for h in range(1, j):
            res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
            res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res2[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
            res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + res[i - h - 1][j - h] * dp2[h] % Mod * C[h][j]) % Mod
        res[i][j] = (res[i][j] + dp[j]) % Mod
        res2[i][j] = (res2[i][j] + dp2[j]) % Mod

print(res2[n][m])
